div.div:
Architecture Notes
• Architecture Layers: External Actor, Application, Sub-agent, Contract, Output
• Orchestration Pattern: Sequential orchestration, Shared-state, Explicit contract
• Core Principle: Judgement Before Execution
• External Dependencies: Claude Code, Google Antigravity, LLM Runtime
• Assumptions:
- Sub-agents execute sequentially.
- Editorial Brief is immutable once produced.
- Articulation consumes but does not modify strategic intent.

div.div:
Detected Pattern: Sequential Skill Orchestration
• ✓ Single-responsibility sub-agents
• ✓ Sequential context enrichment
• ✓ Explicit contract between skills (Editorial Brief)
• ✓ Judgement separated from execution
